title: 2:1 Mux From NAND Gates Only
constraints: Use **only** Verilog `nand` gate primitives, e.g. `nand g1 (out, in1, in2);`. No `assign`, `always`, operators or other gates. 4 gates suffice.
hints: A NAND with both inputs tied together is an inverter.
AND-OR = NAND-NAND: `y = (a·s̄) + (b·s) = NAND(NAND(a, s̄), NAND(b, s))`.
NAND is *universal*: every Boolean function can be built from it, which is why standard-cell libraries are built around it.

forbidden.message: only `nand` gate instances are allowed (no assign, always, operators or other gates)
